info.title: Union Link API
info.description: Public Launcher authentication, member directory and four distribution reads. Administrative and automation operations remain private. API routes, package formats and documentation versions are independent.

servers.description: Current site. Local, preview and production deployments use their own same-origin API.

tags.name: Launcher
tags.description: Server discovery, manifests and package links require member authentication and live organization, access-grant and distribution checks.

SessionCookie.name: mua_session
SessionCookie.description: Administration uses an HttpOnly session cookie; writes also require a same-origin Origin header. Establish browser sessions through login rather than manually entering cookies.

ApiToken.description: Client automation uses Bearer mua_... tokens, not JWTs. Tokens are restricted by server scope, permissions, expiry and the account's current RBAC. They do not authenticate administration endpoints.

get.summary: List servers accessible to the signed-in account
get.description: Returns listed, unarchived servers with a valid bound release, ordered by sortOrder and serverId. Display windows include their start and exclude their end. Expiry hides directory entries only; manifests, downloads and refreshes for otherwise online resources remain available. Times are ISO 8601 strings with a timezone.

200.description: Account-scoped server directory; servers is empty when no resources are visible.

500.description: The service or database is temporarily unavailable.

get.summary: Get the original current release manifest
get.description: Returns sealed original JSON bytes. Verify the signature against these bytes without reserialization. v1 returns mua-client-manifest schemaVersion:2; its digest is not the packaged platform manifest digest. v2 returns mua-recipe-manifest. Obtain public keys through a trusted channel; a key ID does not establish trust.

200.description: Original release manifest with Ed25519 signature headers.

X-MUA-Manifest-Sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original response bytes.

X-MUA-Signature.description: Release manifest signature, distinct from the independent signature of mua-pack.json inside the archive.

400.description: Invalid parameter format, or a base manifest digest without a base release ID.

404.description: The resource is not public, has been archived, deleted or unbound, or the required file/platform artifact is unavailable.

409.description: The fixed package digest no longer matches. Start a new download task; do not resume with different bytes.

415.description: The current release format is not accepted by acceptedFormatVersions. No historical release is selected automatically.

500.description: The service or database is temporarily unavailable.

503.description: The published manifest, base or storage artifact is unreadable, or identity, size or digest validation failed.

get.summary: Discover a full or update package for the current release
get.description:
v1 requires a canonical platform. v2 protocolRevision:2 is platform independent and serves the same recipe on every system. Platform rules do not certify game launch compatibility.

acceptedFormatVersions is required: 1, 2, 1,2 or 2,1. baseReleaseId must identify the publication pinned at upload; include baseManifestSha256 when available. Mismatches select full for the same target. v1 uses the packaged platform manifest digest; v2 uses the original recipe manifest digest. Corrupt baselines fail.

Returns a JSON download descriptor, not ZIP bytes. full always points to the complete package for the same target. Links normally expire after 300 seconds. etag is the original object storage value, including quotes, or null; it is not SHA-256. Use the relative refreshUrl to renew links. Storage GET supports a single Range and If-Match; browsers still require storage CORS. Verify size, SHA-256 and archive signatures after download. Signature parameters depend on the storage provider. Do not modify signed URLs or use a GET URL for HEAD.

200.description: Full or update download descriptor for v1 or v2.

get.summary: Refresh download links for a fixed release
get.description:
v1 requires a canonical platform. v2 protocolRevision:2 is platform independent and serves the same recipe on every system. Platform rules do not certify game launch compatibility.

acceptedFormatVersions is required: 1, 2, 1,2 or 2,1. baseReleaseId must identify the publication pinned at upload; include baseManifestSha256 when available. Mismatches select full for the same target. v1 uses the packaged platform manifest digest; v2 uses the original recipe manifest digest. Corrupt baselines fail.

Returns a JSON download descriptor, not ZIP bytes. full always points to the complete package for the same target. Links normally expire after 300 seconds. etag is the original object storage value, including quotes, or null; it is not SHA-256. Use the relative refreshUrl to renew links. Storage GET supports a single Range and If-Match; browsers still require storage CORS. Verify size, SHA-256 and archive signatures after download. Signature parameters depend on the storage provider. Do not modify signed URLs or use a GET URL for HEAD.

releaseId identifies an unarchived release of the currently online bound client. Historical releases of that client can be refreshed without selecting the latest release. packageSha256 is optional but is always included in generated refreshUrl values; a mismatch returns 409. Archival or unbinding blocks new refreshes, but previously signed links may remain usable until expiry.

post.summary: Verify a game identity and issue a Launcher token
post.description: One-use nonce/verifier checks, online validation against a fixed provider, and account UID/profile ownership verification. gameProfile is an untrusted claim, not a credential; verified CODE:UID identifies the local account. Only approved MUA Yggdrasil Connect adapters are supported; other providers use browser login. Read-only tokens last at most 900 seconds and expire 30 seconds before the upstream token. No refresh token or browser Cookie. Body limit 32768 bytes; game token limit 16384 characters; extra fields, query parameters and Authorization are rejected. Redact credentials and disable caching. Start a new attempt after a used attempt or lost response. Upstream revocation may take the remaining 15-minute lifetime to propagate.
